b2-05-01.title: Communicative Challenge: I Do Not Think So
b2-05-01.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos says that his plan for the weekend is a good idea. You do not agree, and you think it is better to wait.
b2-05-01.prompt: Tell Carlos what you think of his plan.
cues: Say that you do not think it is a good idea
Say that you think it is better to wait
b2-05-01.target: No creo que sea una buena idea; creo que es mejor esperar.
b2-05-01.english: I don't think it is a good idea; I think it is better to wait.
b2-05-01.canDo: I can use no creo que and no me parece que with the subjunctive.

b2-05-02.title: Communicative Challenge: I Doubt It
b2-05-02.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg says that the bus is always on time. You doubt it, but you do not doubt that it is cheap.
cues: Say that you doubt that it is always on time
Say that you do not doubt that it is cheap
b2-05-02.target: Dudo que llegue siempre a la hora, pero no dudo que es barato.
b2-05-02.english: I doubt that it is always on time, but I do not doubt that it is cheap.
b2-05-02.canDo: I can use dudo que and niego que with the subjunctive.

b2-05-03.title: Communicative Challenge: It Is Not That, It Is This
b2-05-03.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks why you do not want to go out tonight. You are not angry with him: you are tired.
cues: Say that you are not angry
Say that the real reason is that you are very tired
b2-05-03.target: No es que esté enojada, sino que estoy muy cansada.
b2-05-03.english: It is not that I am angry, it is that I am very tired.
b2-05-03.canDo: I can reject a reason with no es que and the subjunctive.

b2-05-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Maybe, But…
b2-05-04.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg says that a new schedule at your office will solve every problem. You think she may be right, but you do not think it will be that simple.
cues: Say that she may be right
Say that you do not think it is that simple
b2-05-04.target: Puede ser que tengas razón, pero no creo que sea tan simple.
b2-05-04.english: You may be right, but I do not think it is that simple.
b2-05-04.canDo: I can hedge an opinion with puede ser que and es posible que.

b2-05-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Disagreeing Politely
b2-05-05.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos says that you should accept a plan you are not sure about. You want to disagree politely.
cues: Say that you understand his point of view
Say that you would not call it the best option
b2-05-05.target: Entiendo tu punto de vista, pero no diría que sea la mejor opción.
b2-05-05.english: I understand your point of view, but I wouldn't say it is the best option.
b2-05-05.canDo: I can disagree politely by granting a point and then stating my doubt.

b2-05-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Reading a Book Critically
b2-05-consolidation.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos have read a text about a book of essays on Mexican identity. Carlos says that the book describes all Mexicans. You do not agree.
b2-05-consolidation.prompt: Give Carlos your opinion of the book.
cues: Say that you do not think a book describes all Mexicans
Say that it is possible that it has interesting ideas
b2-05-consolidation.target: No creo que un libro describa a todos los mexicanos, pero es posible que tenga ideas interesantes.
b2-05-consolidation.english: I don't think a book describes all Mexicans, but it is possible that it has interesting ideas.
b2-05-consolidation.canDo: I can say that I do not think, doubt or deny something, with the right mood.
